name: Grounded AI that advances people's goals
vision_statement: Goals keep moving between a person's sessions, because the work they delegated gets done to the standard they wrote, and every answer and action rests on the person's own goals, material and preferences, and never on another person's.
opportunities: unconfirmed: for Joshua to confirm. Other products that need an AI which works from a person's own goals and material could reuse this engine, so the grounding, the standard for delegated work and the scope fences are built once and shared.
solution_coherence: quest-ai-runner turns a person's request or queued task into grounded work in one loop, and do-grounded-work is that loop: do-grounded-work asks the model through call-a-model, remembers through remember-and-recall, keeps the cards in card-store, takes requests in through take-in-the-world, reasons step by step through reason-and-answer, acts through act-as-the-body, holds its work to the metric that serves it through think-critically, has every run watched for risk through watch-for-risk and works in the person's Quest account through access-quest-operations. The other areas of the loop are know-the-world, hold-the-intents and keep-it-generic. take-in-the-world receives a request from talk-over-a-channel, operate-from-a-terminal, assist-a-terminal-session or the package that expose-the-public-api offers. It also lets receive-input-mid-run reach a run that is already working, describes attachments through describe-an-attachment, adds what changed in a work item through feed-context-sources, and hands each request to route-a-message. learn-by-example shows how to use the package through expose-the-public-api. explain-qar documents the package through expose-the-public-api. remember-and-recall recalls the cards that match a request through card-store. select-context ranks stored cards, files and conversations, resolves their references through resolve-references and searches cards and specification records together through search-cards-and-specs. card-store keeps the cards through persist-cards, serves the last known listing through cache-cards while a backend is down, finds them by meaning through index-by-meaning, labels them through label-context-cards, reports stale ones through detect-stale-cards, holds their growth in check through bound-card-growth and shrinks an inflated store through repair-a-card-store. repair-a-card-store rewrites the stored cards through persist-cards and asks choose-what-to-index which sources deserve cards. reason-and-answer rebuilds each step's prompt through assemble-a-prompt, calls call-a-model at the tier choose-a-model-tier picks, answers chat turns through answer-a-turn, reuses requests that worked before through replay-known-operations, classifies inputs through core-ml-tasks, proves a message is handled end to end through answer-end-to-end, and keeps the person informed through reply-in-steps and show-the-ais-work. answer-a-turn, answer-end-to-end, core-ml-tasks, route-a-message, describe-an-attachment and assist-a-terminal-session each ask the model through call-a-model. claim-reach, hand-off-a-goal, operate-a-quest and run-queued-tasks each ask the model through call-a-model. operate-a-quest and run-queued-tasks work in the Quest account through access-quest-operations. ground-in-intent reads the frame of an intent through access-quest-operations. gate-an-autopilot-pass reads each quest's settings through access-quest-operations. draft-a-metric reads the metric card through access-quest-operations and asks the model through call-a-model. call-a-model accounts for every call through justify-model-calls and track-usage-and-cost. reply-in-steps sends the lines of narrate-a-turn and the prose of explain-an-answer, and files the one ask a block only a person can lift needs. show-the-ais-work lays out the steps that show-progress streams. know-the-world answers questions about the world from search-the-web results it checks for support, answering the way answer-a-turn does. think-critically holds deep runs to their metric through iterate-by-spec on the records spec-selection picks, settles narrow questions through judge-a-decision, stops unsafe replies through guard-a-reply, ties work to its purpose through ground-in-intent, tells a stuck run from a slow one through detect-a-stalled-run, drafts a missing metric through draft-a-metric, and keeps background work inside its hours and budget through gate-an-autopilot-pass. act-as-the-body does the work and reports it truthfully. It reads the quest through operate-a-quest, gather-evidence and persist-cards, and claims only the reach that claim-reach grants. It writes files through write-files and reaches Quest's operations through access-quest-operations. It runs queued requests through run-queued-tasks and decides who owns a new goal through hand-off-a-goal. claim-reach hands real work to run-deep-work, write-through-mcp, talk-over-a-channel or gather-evidence. watch-for-risk asks the model through call-a-model to oversee a run and brings a step only a person may take to that person through escalate-to-a-human. escalate-to-a-human files each decision in the Quest account through access-quest-operations. hold-the-intents keeps the long view across turns. It carries what was said and found through remember-conversations and recall-recent-context. It keeps and applies a person's corrections through store-feedback and guide-by-feedback. It saves what was learned through persist-predictions and persist-cards. It keeps work aimed at the person's end through guide-toward-the-long-term-goal, and picks the representative a request runs as through select-a-rep. select-a-rep sends the queued work of that representative through run-queued-tasks. keep-it-generic keeps every part specified as a solution with measured alternatives. It picks the arm that runs through select-an-implementation and finds what a change touches through tag-solutions. It measures whether the assistant acts by ESOI through behave-by-esoi and judge-esoi-behavior. It wires the selected arms per lane through configure-a-lane. It keeps the test suite and the public code trustworthy through verify-offline and keep-secrets-out, and scores how much of QAR's wiring is configuration through @hub-of-hubs/score-hub-connections.
